title: ComfyUI Text-to-Image Workflow
description: Standard txt2img workflow with checkpoint and KSampler.
template:
NODES:
1. CheckpointLoaderSimple - model: [sd_xl_base.safetensors]
2. CLIPTextEncode (Positive) - text: [prompt]
3. CLIPTextEncode (Negative) - text: [negative prompt]
4. EmptyLatentImage - 1024x1024
5. KSampler - steps:20, cfg:7, sampler:dpmpp_2m
6. VAEDecode
7. SaveImage

SETTINGS:
- Steps: 20 (quality) / 12 (speed)
- CFG: 7.0 (balanced) / 5.0 (creative)
- Resolution: 1024x1024 (SDXL)

title: ComfyUI Image-to-Image Workflow
description: Image-to-image workflow for style transfer and editing.
template:
NODES:
1. CheckpointLoader + CLIPTextEncode + KSampler
2. LoadImage + VAEEncode
3. KSampler - denoise: 0.5-0.7
4. VAEDecode + SaveImage

KEY: denoise setting
- 0.3-0.5: Keep original mostly
- 0.5-0.7: Balanced (recommended)
- 0.7-0.9: Mostly new
- 1.0: = text-to-image

title: ComfyUI Upscale Workflow
description: Two-pass upscale for 4x resolution with latent upscaling.
template:
PASS 1: Generate base image (20 steps)
PASS 2: LatentUpscale 2x + KSampler (15 steps, denoise:0.35)

RECOMMENDED UPSCALERS:
- 4x_NMKD-Siax (general)
- 4x-UltraSharp (photorealistic)
- RealESRGAN_x4 (anime)

LOW VRAM: Use Ultimate SD Upscale (tiled)
